_note: 學習路徑內容建置第16批 #6／6：名詞子句的時態呼應（eng.t_adv.nouncl.sequence-of-tenses，學測級／高階）。主要子句動詞為過去式時，名詞子句的動詞通常往過去退一步（現在式→過去式、will→would、can→could）；例外：永遠的事實／真理可保持現在式；主句為現在式時名詞子句不退步。誘答以『該呼應卻不退步／真理誤退步／will 與 would／can 與 could 混用／主句現在式誤退步』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix tsq_）。

units.can_do: 我知道主要子句是過去式時，名詞子句的動詞通常要往過去退一步（現在式→過去式、will→would、can→could）；永遠的事實可保持現在式；主句是現在式時名詞子句不退步。
units.situation_group: 名詞子句時態呼應 Sequence of tenses
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When the main verb is in the past tense, the verb in the noun clause usually shifts back one step (present to past): 'She said that she was tired.'
claims.verification_ref: 主句過去式時名詞子句現在式退為過去式；She said that she was tired；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After a past main verb, 'will' becomes 'would' and 'can' becomes 'could' in the noun clause: 'He said that he would help.'
claims.verification_ref: 主句過去式時 will→would、can→could；He said that he would help；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A general or timeless truth may stay in the present tense even after a past main verb: 'The teacher said that the earth is round.'
claims.verification_ref: 永遠的事實/真理可保持現在式；The teacher said that the earth is round；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the main verb is present, the noun clause keeps its own natural tense (no backshift): 'She says that she is tired.'
claims.verification_ref: 主句現在式時名詞子句不退步；She says that she is tired；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 當主要子句的動詞是『過去式』時，後面名詞子句的動詞通常也要『往過去退一步』，這叫時態呼應：現在式→過去式。She said that she was tired.（她說她很累。said 是過去式→子句用 was。）
She said that she was tired.
teach.zh_hint: 她說她很累。主句 said 過去→子句 was。

teach.body: 助動詞也要呼應：will→would、can→could。He said that he would help me.（他說他會幫我。will→would。）I thought you could swim.（我以為你會游泳。can→could。）
He said that he would call me later.
teach.zh_hint: 他說他晚點會打給我。主句過去→will 變 would。

teach.body: 例外：如果名詞子句講的是『永遠的事實／真理』，可以保持現在式：The teacher said that the earth is round.（老師說地球是圓的——永遠為真。）判斷：主句過去式時，一般內容要呼應退一步，只有普遍真理可留現在式。
The teacher told us that the earth goes around the sun.
teach.zh_hint: 老師告訴我們地球繞著太陽轉——永遠的事實，保持現在式 goes。

practice.stem: 選正確：She said that she ____ very tired after the trip.（她說她旅行後非常累）

distractor_rationales.is: 主句 said 是過去式、又說是『旅行後』已結束的狀態，名詞子句要呼應退一步用過去式 was。
distractor_rationales.will be: 主句過去式，要呼應成 would be 或 was，不用 will be。
distractor_rationales.has been: 與過去主句呼應最自然用 was；has been 若退步應為 had been。

practice.feedback: 主句過去式，子句現在式退為過去式：said that she was tired。

practice.stem: 選正確：He told me that he ____ help me with my homework.（他告訴我他會幫我做功課）

distractor_rationales.will: 主句 told 是過去式，will 要呼應變 would。
distractor_rationales.would be: help 是一般動詞，直接用 would help，不加 be。
distractor_rationales.wills: will 沒有加 -s 的形式。

practice.feedback: 主句過去式，will 變 would：told me that he would help。

practice.stem: 選正確：I thought that you ____ swim very well.（我以為你很會游泳）

distractor_rationales.can: 主句 thought 是過去式，can 要呼應變 could。
distractor_rationales.will can: can 不能和 will 連用。
distractor_rationales.could to: 情態動詞 could 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。

practice.feedback: 主句過去式，can 變 could：I thought that you could swim。

practice.stem: 選正確：The teacher said that the earth ____ around the sun.（老師說地球繞著太陽轉）

distractor_rationales.went: 地球繞太陽是永遠的事實，慣用、也最清楚用現在式 goes；此處選 goes。
distractor_rationales.would go: 永遠的真理不需呼應退步，保持現在式 goes。
distractor_rationales.going: 需要完整動詞 goes，不是 V-ing。

practice.feedback: 永遠的事實保持現在式：the earth goes around the sun。

practice.stem: 選正確：She says that she ____ busy today.（她說她今天很忙）

distractor_rationales.was: 主句 says 是現在式，名詞子句不用退步，用 is。
distractor_rationales.were: 主詞 she 是單數，用 is，不用 were。
distractor_rationales.will was: will 和 was 不能連用，文法錯誤。

practice.feedback: 主句現在式，子句不退步：She says that she is busy。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: He said that he would call me later.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：said that he would call（will 呼應變 would）有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。重音落在呼應後的動詞上、句尾下收。
